description:
Below deck. The sailboat rocks gently. Ammersee stretches out in every direction. Water laps against the hull in soft, irregular rhythms. The cabin creaks. Nothing else. Just the lake breathing.

Recorded near Munich, Bavaria. Late afternoon. The kind of moment you want to bottle up and take home.
